buildWarnings: Build finished with warnings, see the console
dataNotLoaded: The plugin data could not be read (the plugin may have just been reloaded). The action was cancelled so that the stored settings and publish records are not overwritten. Restart SiYuan or re-enable the plugin and try again
settingsSaveFailed: The settings could not be saved; the file on disk was left untouched
settingAccountIdDesc: Detected automatically when empty; fill it in if the token cannot read accounts
settingApiTokenDesc: Needs Cloudflare Pages Edit permission, stored in clear text in this workspace
settingBranchDesc: A non-production branch creates a preview deployment
settingVercelTokenDesc: Create it under Vercel account settings → Tokens, stored in clear text in this workspace
settingEnsureProjectDesc: Creates the project under the name above when it does not exist, otherwise only reads its info
settingManageRecordsDesc: View publish records, copy a link or delete a publish
recordsDeleteQuestion: This removes the remote deployment and the local record. Continue?
recordsDeleteLocalOnly: The channel configuration is incomplete, the remote deployment cannot be deleted. Remove only the local record?
recordUnchanged: The page is unchanged; an existing publish record was found and its link copied
publishUpdatedOk: The page changed; the publish was updated and its link copied
optionAddTitle: Show the document title on top of the page
optionIncludeRefs: Include the documents referenced by the body
optionIncludeRefsDesc: The referenced content (SiYuan's export turns it into the footnote section at the end of the page) plus the documents behind block references, document links and embed blocks; only one level is followed, and turning this off removes all of it
optionToc: Show a table of contents on the right
optionTocDesc: Static anchor links only; moves above the article on narrow screens
optionTocIncludeRefs: List the included referenced documents too
optionTocIncludeRefsDesc: Needs both the table of contents and the included referenced documents
optionPasswordEnabled: Require a password to view this page
unlockPrompt: Enter password to view this page
